section_summary.extract_value: This abstract describes a single study (Study X) examining the relationship between body dissatisfaction, body image flexibility, and body appreciation in a college-bound sample of 84 White older adolescent females. Participants completed self-reported height and weight measurements (for BMI calculation), the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS), and the Body Image-Acceptance and Action Questionnaire (BI-AAQ), with body dissatisfaction operationalized using Pulvers' Figure Rating Scale. The study found that body image flexibility partially mediated the associations between body dissatisfaction and body appreciation, with results retained when controlling for BMI.
